sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: A student evaluates [66 + 8] × 5 - 13: “They multiply 8 by 5 first, then finish the calculation, so the value is 93.” Which statement best identifies the error?
choices: The student multiplied before evaluating [66 + 8]; the grouped sum is 74, giving 357.
The student used the right first step but made an arithmetic slip; the value should be 359.
The work is correct; 93 is the value.
The grouping symbols do not affect the order; 93 is the value.

items.prompt: A student says, “In 6322871, the value of the 2 in the thousands place is 100 times as much as the value of the 2 in the ten-thousands place.” Which statement best analyzes the error?
choices: The values are 2000 and 20000; 2000 is 1/10 as much as 20000, so the student's comparison is incorrect.
Both digits have value 2; repeated digits always have the same value.
The values are 2000 and 20000; 2000 is 10 times as much as 20000.
The values are 2000 and 20000; 2000 is 100 times as much as 20000, so the student's comparison is correct.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Which expression means: “Subtract 6 from 9, multiply the difference by 8, then add 66.”
Which phrase describes 43 + [3 × (7 - 2)] without evaluating it?
choices: Subtract 2 from 7, multiply the difference by 3, then add 43.
Subtract 2 from 7, add 3, then multiply the sum by 43.
Add 7 and 2, multiply the sum by 3, then add 43.

items.prompt: Let E represent 2244 + 4970. Without evaluating, how does 3 × (2244 + 4970) compare with E?
A supply cart has 71 boxes with 89 markers in each box and 9 loose markers. Which expression represents the total number of markers?
A team packs 33 crates with 48 bottles in each crate, adds 73 loose bottles, and then uses 31 bottles. How many bottles remain?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and state the check that would catch an error in it.

items.prompt: In 7833955, how does the value of the 5 in the ones place compare with the value of the 5 in the tens place?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Round each number to the nearest thousand to estimate 649500 - 282500.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
